name: repair_rules_token_clock
description: The repair rules row in the generated_tokens mode, repair_rules.json with the switch clock_mode at generated_tokens and nothing else changed. The tokens the agent's model generates between two calls, each counted as seconds_per_token seconds of the asset file, add up from call to call into one cycle per full think_seconds_per_cycle, so a call is charged the same thinking time whatever the load of the machine that serves the model. A second condition beside repair_rules.json, whose clock is the clock of record, for the layer study.
